context_for_next_testing_agent: The teacher update bugfix is verified working via both backend (pytest PUT tests) and frontend (Playwright UI edit flow). Branches are correctly returned as [{branch_id, branch_name}] dicts fetched dynamically from teacher_branches table. The old string-array 'branches' field on the teachers documents has been cleaned. If retesting, use /app/backend/tests/test_teacher_update_bugfix.py. Note password issue for buse/aysegul teacher logins.
rca_of_the_issue: RCA: MongoDB teachers collection had legacy 'branches' field as list[str] (branch IDs), but the Pydantic Teacher model expects list[dict{branch_id, branch_name}]. When update_teacher ran find_one and returned the doc through the Teacher(**updated) validator, the string entries failed validation → 500 → frontend showed 'güncelleme başarısız'. Fix (already applied): 1) DB cleanup removed old 'branches' field, 2) get/update/create endpoints now always rebuild the branches list from teacher_branches join → branches collection. Verified end-to-end.
